name: Convergence
concept: Six supplied reasons connect through a hand-drawn orthogonal manifold into one studio-and-portal core; the diagram shows relation, not order or workflow.
silhouette: deep teal sectional heading above three paired rows on either side of a rectangular six-strand join
interaction: Pointer, click and keyboard focus on a proof brighten only its decorative strand; all six texts remain present. Without JavaScript the entire manifold remains visible.
safety: The connector is explicitly a visual metaphor, not a chronological payment or delivery workflow. Both illustrative claims retain their adjacent qualifications.
